principles: Prove index parity before cache or rollout
Keep the first slice small and reversible
drivers: Full baseline latency is too high for a default entrypoint
Current runtime memory semantics already have passing smoke coverage
The optimization must not create false proof or stale hidden behavior

options.name: A: Add derived index helper and keep buildMemoryFreshnessPack as the stable public entrypoint
pros: Existing consumers keep the same API
Index behavior can be covered by focused smoke tests
cons: The first slice may still compute source digests directly
Cache and broader consumer rollout remain later work

options.name: B: Rewrite runtime memory around a new service object now
pros: Cleaner long-term layering for index plus cache plus health
Could centralize all future runtime memory behavior at once
cons: Higher risk of breaking existing consumers
Would mix cache/rollout design into the first slice

chosen: A: Add derived index helper and keep buildMemoryFreshnessPack as the stable public entrypoint
rationale: Choose A because M0-M2 needs proof of indexed retrieval parity without widening the public runtime memory contract or changing every consumer at once.

preMortem.scenario: Index returns candidate playbooks as active guidance
preMortem.trigger: Status filtering happens after ranking or is skipped in the index path
preMortem.consequence: Runtime memory could surface unapproved guidance
preMortem.mitigation: Index schema includes status buckets and smoke asserts candidate false-surface remains zero

preMortem.trigger: Rebuild writes directly to active index path
preMortem.consequence: session_brief could show missing or inconsistent memory hits
preMortem.mitigation: Rebuild writes to temporary path, validates manifest/digest, and atomically renames into the active index path

preMortem.scenario: Indexed path diverges from full-scan semantics
preMortem.trigger: Candidate filtering uses token index but misses supersession or deprecated-term side effects
preMortem.consequence: Optimization appears fast but changes correctness
preMortem.mitigation: Add small fixture parity checks for selected ids, suppressed ids, deprecated hits, freshness class, gateEvidence=false, and render bounds
